## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit/integration/UI tests added or updated.
- [ ] `ktlintCheck` passes.
- [ ] Android lint passes for affected code.
- [ ] Relevant build task succeeds.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior changed.

## Privacy, safety, and accessibility

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private health information, or production-only endpoints are committed.
- [ ] Adult health references remain educational and non-diagnostic.
- [ ] No appearance-shaming or pressure-oriented language was introduced.
- [ ] Offline/privacy-first behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Accessibility implications were reviewed.

## Screenshots / recordings

Add UI evidence when applicable. Use fictional/example data only.
